TechstackData.heading: Tech Stack Used for Finance App Development
TechstackData.description: Building a finance application requires a highly secure, scalable, and compliance-driven technology stack. We leverage modern technologies to develop robust fintech solutions such as digital wallets, banking apps, investment platforms, and payment systems with seamless performance and top-tier security.

Frequently.title: How much does finance app development cost in India?
Frequently.desc: Finance app development cost in India depends on the app type, feature set, platform (iOS, Android, or cross-platform), and compliance requirements. A basic finance app with budgeting and expense tracking features typically costs between ₹8–18 lakh ($10,000–$22,000). A mid-complexity banking app or digital wallet with payment gateway integration, KYC flows, and admin panel ranges from ₹25–60 lakh ($30,000–$75,000). A full-scale mobile banking or lending platform with AI features, core banking integration, and multi-platform support can exceed ₹80 lakh ($100,000). Contact our team for a detailed estimate specific to your requirements.

Frequently.title: What is the difference between finance app development and fintech app development?
Frequently.desc: Finance app development is the broader category — it covers any application that helps users or businesses manage, move, or analyze money, including personal budgeting apps, banking apps, investment platforms, and insurance apps. Fintech app development specifically refers to technology-driven innovation in financial services, including digital payments, AI-powered credit scoring, blockchain-based transactions, and neobanking. Comfygen delivers both: traditional banking and finance app development for regulated institutions, and cutting-edge fintech app development services for startups disrupting the financial sector.

Frequently.title: How long does finance app development take?
Frequently.desc: A basic finance or personal budgeting app takes 3–4 months from discovery to launch. A mid-complexity digital wallet or payment app typically takes 5–7 months. A full-scale banking app or lending platform with core banking integration, AI features, and multi-platform support takes 9–14 months. Our agile development process includes bi-weekly demos, so you have visibility at every stage — not just at launch.

Frequently.title: What compliance regulations do you handle in fintech app development?
Frequently.desc: Our fintech app development services are built around regulatory compliance from the first sprint. We design and engineer for PCI-DSS (payment data security), GDPR and India's DPDP Act (data privacy), RBI mobile banking guidelines, SEBI investment platform regulations, KYC/AML requirements (FATF-aligned), and SOC 2 Type II for enterprise clients. For international markets, we additionally cover PSD2 (Europe), FCA regulations (UK), and FinCEN requirements (USA).

Frequently.title: Do you provide fintech mobile app development services for startups?
Frequently.desc: Yes. We offer specific fintech mobile app development services for early-stage startups, including MVP-scoped development, lean architecture that avoids technical debt, and staged compliance implementation that grows with your license and user base. We have worked with pre-seed through Series B fintech startups and understand the difference between what you need on day one and what you need at scale.
